specifications.detail: S1 MOBILITY ONLY: retain the SLEEVELESS TEAL/CHARCOAL racing suit and three-quarter fitted legwear, open shoulders/arms and calf gap above low boots. Keep central sternum+two rib armor sections minimal/slim. specifications.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Make a STRICTLY LOCAL DESIGN EDIT to the supplied2row×4column tier board.
ONLY the RIGHTMOST S/ADVANCED column, both EDEL and SERIN, may receive a new outfit treatment. Keep C BASIC, B STANDARD and A MODULAR's clothing/armor/face/hair/pose/labels/details as supplied. Preserve their design and placement; do not redesign or enrich them. Keep overall framing and all8 main figures in place.
User likes role silhouette/BASIC and the stronger B/A structure; requests ONLY ADVANCED to look clearly HIGHEST TIER, more NEAR-FUTURE TECH SUIT and more beautifully ORNAMENTED.

ADVANCED S ONLY:
Keep its current three-part compact front/rib protection and connected frame, role garment cut and original exposed joint positions. Elevate the underlying SUIT as well as armor: clearly designed segmented technical-textile panels, sophisticated matte/satin/composite material transitions, refined tapered seam routes, highly finished protective edges and integrated slim glove/boot interfaces. No increased body exposure or adult body proportions.
Create a distinct premium-near-future signature visible in main character view: slim PLATINUM/DARK-SILVER inlaid edge trims around the segmented panels, precision machined connection nodes, a small sculptural technical collar clasp, three-ridge geometric ornamental metal tab at one shoulder/waist, fine etched angular pattern on armor/fabric inset (NOT SKIN), coordinated role-color enamel inserts in fasteners and restrained tiny recessed LIGHT LINES along two suit/gear seam routes. Light accents subtle and controlled, no full-body neon/bloom, no magical aura.
Decorative richness must be OBVIOUS but tailored and technical, not just extra pouches or huge armor. Refine seam geometry/collar/glove/calf interfaces into a genuinely more sophisticated suit than A. Small ornamental hardware/fine geometric inlays should convey highest-grade manufacture. Do not add dangling jewelry, fantasy brooches/chains, gold filigree, capes, long pointed cloth tails, wings, knight pauldrons, spiky greaves, giant chest boxes or pile of thick armor.
Maintain the role's palette and functional identity, no homogenized universal sci-fi suit across roles. Bare skin remains clean, no tattoos, marking or circuit lines on skin. All pattern/inlay/light belongs on opaque suit/armor ONLY. Torso/pelvis securely covered, neutral nonsexual pose, no cleavage/sheerness/lingerie/anatomy exaggeration.
Keep original EDEL lavender braid/loop ahoge/blue eyes and SERIN brown ponytail/pink cap/rose-brown eyes/SD short limbs. No new weapons/helmets/hair ornaments. Proposed luminous/ornamental details are VISUAL CONCEPT ONLY, not implemented abilities, functions or game-ready assets.
S header may read "ADVANCED / SIGNATURE FUTURE SUIT", exact S code retained. Other tier headers/layout and any non-S inset panels remain as supplied. S closeups may show the new precision trim/material/connection pattern. Full hair/boots visible. Same refined anime illustration and soft studio backdrop.
Footer "4 PRODUCTS / 2 CHARACTER VIEWS EACH / DESIGN PROPOSAL / NOT 3D FITTED".
